fix(ci): configure global git auth for submodule clone in ci-debug-parity (refs #247)

The prompts submodule clone was failing with:
  fatal: could not read Username for '<url>': No such device or address

Root cause: actions/checkout sets http.<ip-url>.extraheader in LOCAL git
config only. git submodule update spawns git clone as a subprocess, which
reads GLOBAL/SYSTEM configs but NOT the parent repo's local config.
Result: clone gets HTTP 401, git prompts for credentials via /dev/tty,
fails because no TTY exists in the container.

Fix: before git submodule update, write the AUTHORIZATION: basic header
to the GLOBAL git config (~/.gitconfig) so all spawned git subprocesses
inherit it. Also add GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 as a belt-and-suspenders guard.

fix(ci): use direct submodule URL override instead of url.insteadOf (refs #247)

url.insteadOf is unreliable for git submodule update --init: git
registers the hostname URL into .git/config during the init phase,
then clones from the cached URL without re-applying the rewrite.

Fix: split the operation explicitly:
  1. git submodule init prompts   (registers hostname URL in .git/config)
  2. git config submodule.prompts.url <ip-url>  (override to IP)
  3. git submodule update prompts  (clone via the overridden IP URL)

The IP URL is derived dynamically from the extraheader git config
that the checkout action sets for the IP-based Gitea server URL.
No IP hardcoding required.

fix(ci): use noceph build tag to exclude CGo from golangci-lint in CI

The .golangci.yml path exclusion (previous approach) only suppresses
reporting issues from pkg/ceph/; golangci-lint still needs to COMPILE
the package to analyse it, causing librados.h: No such file or directory.

Correct fix: add noceph build tag so golangci-lint uses the existing
darwin stub instead of the CGo SDK file:
- pkg/ceph/diagnostics_sdk.go: !darwin && !noceph (real SDK, needs librados)
- pkg/ceph/diagnostics_sdk_stub.go: darwin || noceph (stub, no CGo)
- .golangci.yml run.build-tags: add noceph

With the noceph tag set, golangci-lint compiles diagnostics_sdk_stub.go
(pure Go, no C headers) and lint succeeds without librados-dev.
Normal go build (without noceph) still uses the real SDK on Linux.

Verified: golangci-lint run ./pkg/ceph/... reports lint issues but no
compilation errors. ci:debug passes all 11 stages locally.
